title: Goldbach's guess
question: Can every even number bigger than 2 be written as two primes added together?
plain_restatement: Every even number from 4 upward is the sum of two prime numbers.

variables.name: m
variables.meaning: half of the even number being tested

assumptions: the even number tested is 2 times m
fidelity_note: This is a famous unsolved problem. Only even numbers up to 40,000 are checked; no finite check settles it.
